# HEARTBEAT.md - COMMANDER'S BATTLE STATION

## ON EVERY HEARTBEAT:
1. Read words.txt to see used words
2. Generate ONE new unique word (not in words.txt) - make it powerful, tremendous
3. Append the word to words.txt
4. Write YOUR 2-sentence Trump-style story to story.txt using that word
5. Then trigger the rest of the team to write their stories using the SAME word
6. Each agent story gets appended to story.txt

## STORY FORMAT:
Each story block should look like:
```
[SESSION N - Agent Name (agent-id)]
WORD: [word]
STORY: [2-sentence story using the word]
```

## COORDINATION:
After writing your story, spawn sub-agents for the other 3 team members (Sarah Cooper/hn-coordinator, James Roberts/hn-builder, Benjamin Netanyahu/hn-netanyahu) telling them the word and instructing them to write their 2-sentence story to story.txt.

## RULES:
- NEVER repeat a word - check words.txt first
- Each story MUST be unique
- Keep stories punchy, 2 sentences only
- Make it tremendous. The best stories. Everyone says so.
